_doc: Machine-readable target bands for tools/balance/sim.py. The prose and rationale live in docs/kb/design/balance_targets.md; change both together. Bands are inclusive [min, max] win percentages per policy; null = reported, no band. Each suite names the loadout (gear and consumables) its bands assume. mean_turns_min (optional) maps a policy to its ease ceiling: the fewest mean turns it may take, so a band that sits at 100% still catches a regression that makes the fight easier. swell (M2-CMB-01, optional): the quality every hero's Swell input is played at when a policy unleashes a full gauge (off, miss, good or perfect; default off). naive never unleashes. naive_swell (M2-NIT-03) is naive plus the Swell row, report only (null) in every suite but a kind 'vowbound' one: balance_targets.md says when its rate needs a decision. A 'vowbound' suite (M2-CMB-05, ADR 0027) gives naive_swell, the masher who calls the Vowbound at once, the Vowbound masher line as its band, with the heroes' Swell off as the line was measured.
